'''Larkin nerfs''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Pii III]]. They had a mild temperament and a herbivorous [[Diet/Legends|diet]].<ref name="Greel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larkin nerfs were mentioned in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," an article featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[May]] of [[1995]] for their ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Greel" />
